description:
The Purple Pie frameset is the most direct expression of the platform’s philosophy. It exists for riders who don’t want the final character of their bike decided at checkout, but prefer to define it deliberately, step by step. This is not an unfinished option—it is the Purple Pie distilled to its core.

At the heart of the frameset sits the Pinion gearbox, and with it a fundamentally different approach to drivetrain design. Mass is concentrated low and centrally within the frame, shaping the bike’s handling long before any other component choices are made. The result is a ride that feels planted, calm and predictable from the first pedal stroke.

Geometry, tubing and construction are identical to every complete Purple Pie build. Nothing is simplified or reduced. The frameset carries the same terrain‑focused intent: stability on loose ground, control over mixed surfaces and comfort that builds over distance rather than fading. The bike feels settled rather than reactive, encouraging confidence rather than correction.

What the frameset removes is assumption. Wheels, cockpit, braking components and even riding context are left open. What remains is a clear, stable foundation designed to support deliberate decisions rather than dictate outcomes.

The Purple Pie frame is built around the Pinion system from the ground up. Load paths, stiffness distribution and compliance are tuned to work with the gearbox’s central mass, creating a balanced ride that remains consistent across varied builds.

Unlike frames that merely accept internal gearboxes, the Purple Pie treats the drivetrain as a structural and dynamic element. The benefits are tangible: improved balance, predictable traction and handling that changes very little when baggage, surface or route evolves.

This makes the frameset especially suitable for riders who plan to adapt their bike over time. Whether built light and focused, or gradually equipped for year‑round use, the core ride feel remains unmistakably Purple Pie.

Choosing the frameset means embracing intention. Gearbox configuration remains fixed by design, but everything around it is open to interpretation. Riders can prioritise weight, durability, comfort or autonomy without compromising the bike’s underlying balance.

The frame is equally at home supporting minimalist off‑road builds and more complete, everyday‑ready configurations. Mounting options, clearances and geometry are designed to accommodate this range without forcing the bike toward a single definition of use.

It is a frameset for riders who know how they ride—or who want a platform that allows that understanding to evolve organically.

Every Purple Pie frameset is finished individually. Frame size, colour and selected mounting options are defined during ordering before the frame is assembled and prepared in our workshop. This is not an anonymous component; it is a finished product in its own right.

The result is a frame that already feels resolved before the build begins. When components are added, they complete an idea rather than compensate for an absence.

The Purple Pie frameset isn’t the quickest way to a finished bike. It’s the most deliberate one. It exists for riders who value long‑term relevance, mechanical calm and a riding experience shaped by balance rather than trend.

Nothing here is undecided by accident. Everything left open is left open on purpose.

A centred, terrain‑focused frameset.Defined by the stability of a Pinion drivetrain and the freedom of open configuration.Curated for riders who want to shape their bike intentionally—and ride it for a long time without feeling the need to start over.

All Sour Bicycles frames are made by hand, one-by-one, in our own facility in Saxony, just outside of Dresden. We use custom tubing designed and drawn for our frames, it’s a multi-butted heat-treated CrMo steel that’s ready to stand the test of time. Our steel tubes come from specialised tube makers in Taiwan and Europe – custom drawn, multi-butted and partly heat-treated to our own specifications. Every frame is then welded by hand in our workshop in Saxony.

Our dropouts are designed in-house in Dresden and cast made for us.

The seat clamp is designed in-house as well and is integrated into the frame. Should it ever fail, the frame can be professionally modified to use a traditional clamp, if repair of the original clamp is not possible. We have never seen one fail.

The Business Fork is our carbon gravel and adventure fork designed for all the adventures, big and small!

We designed this fork in-house and worked with our long-term production partner in China to make it. We have tested this fork at EFBE in Germany and pass their Tri-Test with flying colors!

Below are the frame weights for each size of the Sour Purple Haze. These weights do not include powdercoating, but please keep in mind that your chosen powdercoat may be heavier than the average coating we use. Fades, gradients, and metallic colours can weigh more than single solid colour powdercoat. If you are interested the final weight, please get in touch. Weights are averaged over three frames per size. We apply a wax coating on the inside of the frame for rust prevention, this will also add a small amount of weight.

Included with your Purple Pie frame or frameset is all the grommets and small parts to run any cabling you wish (as longh ist it’s internal lol) You get a rear thru-axle of course, and if you’re ordering a frameset, you get a front axle with your fork as well. Headsets are only included if you add one to your order.
